name: get_storage_stores_by_id
description:
Retrieve a Vercel storage store by ID for the authenticated account or selected team. The optional skipMetadata and includeGuides flags control whether metadata is omitted and guides are included.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} storage get {storeId}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
